ResourcesPage.footer: More resources for developers and writers available at

repo.ai: Artificial intelligence tools, prompts, skills, and model configurations for the Xscriptor ecosystem.
repo.colors: All Xscriptor color palettes in one place — themes for terminals, editors, and IDEs.
repo.web: Web projects and UI components — Samurai security platform, Shinobi scraper, and the Xcomponents library.
repo.fresh: A collection of custom color themes for Fresh, the terminal text editor
repo.hyprland: A clean, performance-oriented Hyprland configuration featuring a [X] aesthetic, optimized for productivity and seamless workflow on X and Arch Linux
repo.jetbrains: Essential settings and customizations to improve accessibility and personalization of JetBrains IDEs using the Xscriptor ecosystem (themes, snippets...)
repo.obsidian: An elegant Obsidian theme for coders and writers with beautiful EB Garamond typography and flexible customization.
repo.opencode: An interactive CLI agent that helps with software engineering tasks directly from your terminal.
repo.vscode: A complete suite of customizations for VSCode & Forks, including themes, code snippets, and UI mods.
repo.x: Scripts for x, including the main x.sh entrypoint and modular add-ons. The base script installs the x wrapper, applies required system configuration after installation.
repo.xclock: A terminal-based clock application written in Rust, inspired by ttyclock. It features a digital clock with ASCII art, countdown timers, and various customization options.
repo.xfetch: A fast, lightweight, and highly customizable system information fetcher for the terminal, built in Rust. Display your system info with style and flexibility.
repo.xtop: Xtop, a modern, cross-platform TUI system monitor written in Rust. Inspired by btop, it leverages ratatui and sysinfo to provide real-time monitoring.
repo.xglass: A glassmorphism VS Code theme with translucent backgrounds and vibrant accents.
repo.oxt: Extended tooling and utilities for the Xscriptor development ecosystem.

JetBrainsPage.title: resources/
JetBrainsPage.description: A collection of 12 city-inspired themes for IntelliJ-based IDEs. Nine dark schemes and three light schemes, all built on the IntelliJ Platform 2025.3+ with Islands UI support.
JetBrainsPage.feature1: 12 city-inspired color schemes (9 dark, 3 light) across all IntelliJ-based IDEs
JetBrainsPage.feature2: Islands UI support for JetBrains IDEs 2025.3+ with full editor scheme integration
JetBrainsPage.feature3: Automated theme generation pipeline: edit colors.md, run generate_themes.py, deploy
JetBrainsPage.feature4: Comprehensive syntax highlighting for Java, Kotlin, Python, JavaScript, TypeScript, CSS, HTML, XML, Ruby, PHP, Go, Markdown, and RegExp
JetBrainsPage.feature5: Gradle-based build with IntelliJ Platform Plugin 2.x, Java 21 toolchain, and CI/CD integration
JetBrainsPage.themesDesc: All 12 schemes are organized around iconic cities, each with its own distinct color identity.
JetBrainsPage.installMarketplaceDesc: Open your IDE, go to Settings > Plugins > Marketplace, search for Xscriptor Theme, and click Install.
JetBrainsPage.installManualCmd: Download the plugin ZIP from GitHub releases and install via Settings > Plugins > Install Plugin from Disk.
JetBrainsPage.installBuildCmd:
git clone https://github.com/xscriptor/jetbrains
cd jetbrains/xscriptor-theme
./gradlew buildPlugin
JetBrainsPage.scriptsDesc: The repository ships with a Python script that parses colors.md and generates all 12 .theme.json files and .xml editor schemes automatically.
JetBrainsPage.scriptsExample:
# Generate all themes from colors.md
python3 scripts/generate_themes.py --output ./output

ObsidianPage.title: resources/
ObsidianPage.description: A refined literary-inspired theme for Obsidian, featuring EB Garamond typography and flexible customization for any workspace.

features.ebGaramond: Elegant EB Garamond typography with full italic and weight support
features.lightDark: Carefully tuned light and dark color palettes
features.codeBlocks: Enhanced code block readability with per-language backgrounds
features.styleSettings: Full Style Settings integration for real-time customization

ObsidianPage.installCommunityDesc: From Obsidian: Settings → Appearance → Community Themes → Search for Xscriptor and click Install.
ObsidianPage.installManualCmd: Copy the theme files into .obsidian/themes/Xscriptor/ and select it in Settings → Appearance
ObsidianPage.styleSettingsDesc: The theme integrates with the Style Settings plugin, giving you full control over transparency, colors, and typography.

settings.transparencyDesc: Control the transparency level of the application background.
settings.micaDesc: Enable a frosted glass blur effect over the workspace (requires translucent background).
settings.accentDesc: Customize the main accent color used across the theme.
settings.typographyDesc: Adjust base font size and line height for optimal readability.

ObsidianPage.devIntro: This theme ships with a Python automation toolkit that lets you generate your own custom Obsidian themes programmatically. The pipeline follows a declarative JSON-to-CSS workflow:
ObsidianPage.devQuickPaletteDesc: From just 8 color values and 4 background tones, the quick palette engine auto-derives approximately 150 CSS variables covering surfaces, borders, hovers, focus rings, callouts, tags, code blocks, and syntax tokens for both light and dark modes.
ObsidianPage.devFastPaletteDesc: Define just 2 emphasis colors and the script computes the full heading hierarchy (h1–h6), italic, muted, and faint tones automatically using configurable strength ratios.
